While the WebSurfer correctly retrieved the birth dates (Ela Gandhi: July 1, 1940; Sebastián Borensztein: April 22, 1963), the Planner incorrectly stated that "Sebastián Borensztein: Born 1927" in its analysis. This is a hallucination of data that contradicts the evidence gathered in the previous step. Consequently, the Planner drew the wrong conclusion that Borensztein was born earlier, when in reality, Ela Gandhi (1940) was born earlier than Borensztein (1963). The error stems from misinterpreting or fabricating the retrieved data during the comparison phase.
